title: debregeasia leucophylla
intro: Debregeasia leucophylla, commonly known as the Himalayan nettle, is a plant species belonging to the family Urticaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and digestive issues. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, which include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it beneficial for wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Debregeasia leucophylla include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
